notes: **Better Graphics designs (nightly AI training: designs).** Scored on a new benchmark of 81 designs across five brands: 7.9 → 9.1 out of 10. Quotes and reviews are kept whole with the person's name; events get their day, time and place as pills and a button; offers get a headline, the terms and a button; stats keep their sign and unit and big numbers fit the width; headlines start with a capital

**Readable colours everywhere:** text colour is now picked by real contrast (also in motion graphics), brand colours used as text are adjusted until they read, and a logo that would disappear into a light background is shown in one solid colour
The AI's design know-how gained checkable rules and worked examples. New quality scoreboard: docs/QUALITY.md
